description.value: The Pastry Portal is an artisan pastry cafe in Downtown Abbotsford offering a rotating weekly menu of fresh-baked croissants, donuts, specialty cookies, and lunch items alongside hand-crafted espresso and matcha drinks featuring Smoking Gun beans. The cafe operates on unceded Stó:lō territory and emphasizes a welcoming community atmosphere. Touring cyclists will find a convenient stop for baked goods and specialty coffee, including a selection of gluten-free options.

address.value: 2553 Montrose Ave Unit 120, Abbotsford, BC V2S 3T4

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: rack (3 spaces) at 45m; rack (3 spaces) at 83m. Total: 6 spaces.
